'''AceMace''' (GEMP handle '''AceMace''') won the [[2026 Scrapyard Scrum]], defeating [[Matthew Ford]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="ss26" /> He finished 3rd at the [[2025 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase]].<ref name="ssb" />
